toolbar.save.tip: Save in place (overwrites the opened file where your browser supports it)
toolbar.exportPdf.tip: Export this catalog as a printable A4 PDF — a QR code next to each item that has a Buy link
toolbar.search.tip: Search every row in this catalog, not just the current image
toolbar.storeSettings.tip: Configure this catalog's store link and Buy-button behavior
toolbar.startCollab.tip: Start a live session others can join to edit this catalog with you
images.none: No images in this catalog yet.
stage.select: Select an image on the left, or add a new one.
hotspot.tip: {url} — drag to reposition, click to edit
column.name: Name
image.title: Image
link.new.title: New link (hotspot)
link.new.hint: A hotspot's Address is what ties it to a row in the table below — several hotspots can share the same Address when the same part is drawn more than once on this diagram, and they'll all point to that one row.
link.reuse.label: Same part as an existing hotspot? (optional)
link.name: Link name
link.placeHint: Click on the image to place a hotspot.
link.edit.title: Edit link
link.edit.position: Position: top={top}, left={left} (drag the hotspot on the image to move it)
link.edit.address: Address, unique across the whole catalog
links.title: Links on this image ({count})
links.hint: Click a row (or its hotspot on the image) to edit or delete it.
row.new.title: New table row
row.addLinkFirst: Add a link with no data row first.
row.edit.title: Edit table row
row.edit.address: Address: {url} (change the hotspot's address to repoint this row)
rows.hint: Click a row to edit its name, SKU, description or extra characteristics.
rows.hint@education: Click a row to edit its name, code, description or extra characteristics.
rows.hint@fitness: Click a row to edit its name, number, description or extra characteristics.
extra.label: Extra characteristics
extra.invalidJson: The "extra characteristics" field must be a valid JSON object.
extra.duplicate.one: Key {list} is entered twice — only the last value for each will be kept. Save anyway?
extra.duplicate.other: Keys {list} are entered twice — only the last value for each will be kept. Save anyway?
search.hint: Type to search across every image's table.
remote.title: Copy remote catalog
remote.hint: Fetches a copy to edit locally — it won't stay linked to that URL, use Save/Export to keep your changes. The host must allow cross-origin requests (CORS).
store.title: Store settings
store.type.commercial: Commercial — labeled "Buy" / "Cart", as a store catalog
store.type.education: Education — same buttons relabeled "Learn more" / "Collection" (📚), nothing else changes
store.type.fitness: Fitness — buttons read "Watch exercise" / "My workout" (🏋️), nothing else changes
store.url.label: Store URL (for your own reference)
store.behavior.accumulate: Add to cart, checkout for everything at once
store.behavior.accumulate@education: Add to collection, open everything at once
store.behavior.accumulate@fitness: Add to workout, open everything at once
store.behavior.instant: Go straight to payment for each item
store.behavior.instant@education: Open each item's own link right away
store.behavior.instant@fitness: Open each machine's own link right away
store.recipe.summary: Advanced: how to combine items into one cart (defaults work for Payhip)
store.recipe.idPattern: Item ID pattern (regex, one capture group)
store.recipe.hint: A row's buy_url is only combinable if it matches the Item ID pattern above. Its captured id is substituted into the per-item parameter (once per item, joined with "&"), then appended to the base URL. Anything that doesn't match still joins the cart above, it just opens on its own instead of merging into that combined link.
store.view.images: Images — same as before this setting existed
store.view.diagram: Diagram — skip straight to the clickable image
store.view.table: Table — skip straight to the data table
store.view.hint: Only visible below the mobile-tab breakpoint (an embed in a narrow container, or an actual phone) — above it, Images/Diagram/Table already all show at once.
pdf.title: Export PDF
pdf.qr.hint: A tile catalog's own on-corner QR is unaffected either way.
pdf.qr.hintNoStore: This catalog has no items linked to an online store, so there's nothing to put a QR code on.
collab.tip: Share this link so a colleague can join: {link}
collab.tipPending.one: {count} edit not sent yet — still editing locally, will send once reconnected. {tip}
collab.tipPending.other: {count} edits not sent yet — still editing locally, will send once reconnected. {tip}
collab.end.tip: Ends the session for everyone, not just this tab
collab.notFound.title: Can't find a collaboration server
collab.notFound.body.html: Make sure the ECM Collaboration Server app is running on your computer, then try again.
collab.notFound.manual: Or enter its address by hand
collab.notFound.manualHint: If it's running on a different computer, paste in its address.
collab.name.title: Join as…
collab.name.body: Pick a name so others in this session know who's who — no account needed.
collab.name.label: Your name
collab.share.title: Share this session
collab.share.body: Anyone with this link — or who scans this code — can join and edit alongside you. It stays live for as long as this session runs.
collab.status.notFound: Could not find a running collaboration server.
collab.confirm.noPublicUrl: Found your collaboration server, but it doesn't have a public address yet (still connecting, or its tunnel isn't available). You can continue — this tab will work — but the link won't work for a colleague until that's ready. Continue anyway?
collab.status.started: Started a shared session — share the link shown below with a colleague.
collab.error.start: Could not start a shared session — is the collaboration server at {server} still running? ({detail})
collab.error.join: Could not join that shared session — is the collaboration server at {server} still running? ({detail})
collab.error.end: Could not end the shared session — is the collaboration server at {server} still running? ({detail})
collab.status.left: Left the shared session — you're back to working locally.
collab.status.ended: Ended the shared session for everyone — you're back to working locally.
collab.confirm.end: End this shared session for everyone? Anyone still connected will be disconnected — they'll keep their own current copy, but the live session ends. This can't be undone.
collab.closed.byName: {by} ended this shared session — you're back to working locally with your current copy.
collab.closed.ended: This shared session was ended — you're back to working locally with your current copy.
collab.closed.serverStopped: The collaboration server was stopped — you're back to working locally with your current copy.
collab.status.linkCopied: Copied the link — share it with whoever you want editing alongside you.
collab.status.copyFailed: Couldn't copy automatically — here's the link: {link}
collab.status.remoteOpFailed: Couldn't apply a change from the shared session: {message}
status.converting: Converting legacy .sch catalog… this can take a moment for large files.
status.converted.one: Converted legacy catalog "{name}" ({count} image). Save to keep it as a .{ext} file.
status.converted.other: Converted legacy catalog "{name}" ({count} images). Save to keep it as a .{ext} file.
status.convertedSkipped.one: Converted legacy catalog "{name}" ({count} image, {skipped} skipped). Save to keep it as a .{ext} file.
status.convertedSkipped.other: Converted legacy catalog "{name}" ({count} images, {skipped} skipped). Save to keep it as a .{ext} file.
status.saveLocationFailed: Could not choose a save location: {message}
status.changedOnDisk: "{name}" changed since you opened it — probably saved by someone else in the meantime. Overwrite it with your changes anyway? ("Export a copy…" keeps both instead of choosing.)
status.downloadedCopy: Downloaded a copy (this browser can't save in place — "Open catalog…" it again next time).
image.cantDelete.one: Can't delete "{name}" — it still has {count} hotspot on it.
image.cantDelete.other: Can't delete "{name}" — it still has {count} hotspots on it.
image.confirmDeleteRows.one: Delete "{name}"? It still has {count} data row with no hotspot, which go with it. This can't be undone.
image.confirmDeleteRows.other: Delete "{name}"? It still has {count} data rows with no hotspot, which go with it. This can't be undone.
link.conflict.name: Name "{value}" is already used by another hotspot in this catalog.
link.conflict.address: Address "{value}" is already used by another hotspot in this catalog.
link.conflict.footer: This is fine if it's the same part drawn again elsewhere. Save anyway?
link.cantDelete: Can't delete this hotspot — its table row ("{url}") is still there. Delete the row first.
link.confirmDelete: Delete this hotspot? This can't be undone.
row.confirmDelete: Delete this table row? Its hotspot stays on the image, just unassigned from any data. This can't be undone.
